rounds.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (critique agent, separate from the builder)

problems.what: the hook is an empty pink frame: at frame 0 only the bottom edge of the drop shows at the top, the splash waits until 1.0 s and the first headline letter until 1.2 s
problems.fix: start with the drop inside the frame, land and splash on beat 1 (0.5 s), and start the headline with the splash

problems.what: the free-window tags are 31 px (vertical) and 26 px (landscape): unreadable at phone width in landscape, marginal in vertical; the booked pills (00:19.5-00:22.0) are the same size
problems.fix: set every tag at 44 px; make room for them (vertical: a taller diamond and tags clamped to the safe area; landscape: tags and booked pills staggered above and below the row)

problems.what: merges are soft: each pair sits necked for about 30 frames and then glides together; nothing marks the merge but a whoosh
problems.fix: an accelerating approach so the neck forms only in the last few frames, a fast spring snap that completes on the merge frame, a bigger overshoot, and a hit on each merge

problems.what: the liquid wipe reads as the light gloss violet, not solid deep: the f = 1.8 gloss contour of the huge wipe ball covers almost the whole frame
problems.fix: paint the wipe ball's own surface in solid deep over the gloss

problems.what: while the wipe drains, its field swells the lockup blob and pulls a neck from it down through the wordmark; in landscape the blob covers the 'O' of 'Oriel'
problems.fix: after the frame is covered, draw the draining wipe as its own circle over a lockup-blob field that does not include it

problems.what: the 'booked' copy fades in while the landing droplet is still a pointed lemon shape half turned into a pill
problems.fix: start the copy only after the pill has formed; soften the landing squash

problems.what: every blob reads as a light violet plate with a thin deep rim, not deep goo with a highlight: the f = 1.8 contour of an r²/d² field sits at about 0.75 r, so the brief's 'only highlight' covers over half the area
problems.fix: the brief's number and its intent disagree; raise the gloss level (about 2.6) only if composition stays under 8

problems.what: the pinch-off satellite droplets are almost all gloss, so they read as light dots rather than tiny deep drops
problems.fix: minor; a consequence of the gloss level

rounds.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (critique agent, separate from the builder)

pace.note: the metric counts whole-frame mean shifts over 18 grey levels; on a flat pink ground with small blobs only a full-frame event can trip it, and the wipe no longer holds a solid frame (round 1's single 'change' was that hold). Variety is scored by eye: splash at 0.5 s, tags on each beat, three snapped merges with hits, the card hit, four landings, the wipe.

fixed: hook: the drop is inside the frame at frame 0, lands at frame 10 and splashes on beat 1 (frame 15, 0.5 s); 'Four calendars.' starts at frame 14 with a faster letter stagger and is whole by about 0.9 s

merges: the approach starts gently and then accelerates (t⁴), so each neck lives about 8 frames, and a fast spring (3.2 Hz) snaps the merge on its frame with a larger overshoot; the vertical pairs ease apart while they form so the final merge has pink to close; a hit now sounds on each merge (270, 300, 345)

tags: 44 px in both sizes (were 31 and 26); vertical diamond stretched (740 / 1070 / 1400) and tags clamped to the safe area; landscape tags and booked pills alternate above and below the row so they never collide; booked pills 390 × 88

wipe: the wipe ball's own surface is painted solid deep over the gloss, it covers the frame exactly on the whoosh (660) and drains from the next frame (no dead hold); after 660 it is drawn as its own circle over a lockup-blob field that does not include it, so the lockup blob never necks through the wordmark
booked copy appears only after the pill has formed (land + 14), and the landing squash is softer
mix gain 0.68 -> 0.77: the added hits raised the peak of the peak-normalised mix and pulled it to -17.1 LUFS; now -16.0
cueChanges: splash tick pair moved from frames 30/33 to 15/18 (the brief's cue table says 30)
hits added on the merges at 270, 300 and 345, alongside the brief's whooshes

problems.what: the blobs still read as light plates with a deep rim, because the brief's f = 1.8 gloss covers over half of each blob
problems.fix: a brief-level choice; raise the gloss level to about 2.6 if the owner wants a true highlight

problems.what: the pinch-off satellite droplets still read as light dots (mostly gloss)
each landing droplet passes through a pointed lemon shape for a few frames as the pill field forms; no copy sits on it any more
'Thu · 3:00 pm' fades while the card starts to drain, so for a few frames it shows as broken letter shapes
problems.fix: fade the copy out two or three frames earlier if it bothers
